gaps.sentence: Factory workers are paid ___ at the end of each week.
gaps.hint: pay for manual work, usually weekly
gaps.explanation: 'Wages' are paid weekly, often in cash, for manual or unskilled work; salaries are monthly.

gaps.sentence: He gave a ___ summary of the 40-page report.
gaps.explanation: 'A brief summary' — adjective; 'briefly' is the adverb.
'Than' is used in comparisons; 'then' refers to time or consequence.

gaps.sentence: He ___ her on her presentation and her handling of questions.
He ___ all knowledge of the missing file.
gaps.explanation: 'Deny all knowledge of something' is the fixed phrase.

gaps.sentence: I'm exhausted — I need to ___ down and rest.
gaps.hint: to recline — no object; forms: lie, lay, lain
gaps.explanation: 'Lie' (lie, lay, lain) means to recline and takes no object; 'lay' (lay, laid, laid) means to put something down and takes an object.

gaps.sentence: Please state your ___ on the application form.
gaps.hint: the formal word for your type of work, used on forms
gaps.explanation: 'Occupation' is the formal word for a person's job or profession, typically used on official forms.

gaps.sentence: This tooth is ___ and will probably fall out soon.
gaps.explanation: 'Loose' is an adjective meaning not firmly fixed; 'lose' is the verb meaning to no longer have.
